title: Move along... find a different product!
text:
Move along... find a different product!. Do yourself a favor.. just don't. VERY cheaply made. The instruction manual that comes with the product is wrong in telling you how to set it up and get it started and when I called customer service, they were extremely nasty.

It technically "works", but everything about it is cheap and it feels as if it won't last very long and the last thing we need is a large water spillage due to a cheaply made product. Maybe if you are using it somewhere where you absolutely don't care if it will spill or break, you can save some money to get this thing... but if you want something for your kitchen or office or anywhere else you don't want to one day find water everywhere... get something different.

We opted to just pay the $13 to send it back and spend more money on a highly rated unit.

product_metadata.title: Avanti WD31EC Table Top Thermoelectric Water Cooler
